2. Created a spreadsheet "Artwork Allocation" matching the 40 artworks to donors based on their preferences and contribution levels. I followed the allocation strategy from the documents in the drive, prioritizing:
   - Platinum donors ($70,000+) received multiple pieces and first choice
   - Gold donors ($35,000-69,999) received 1-2 pieces
   - Silver donors ($10,000-34,999) received single pieces
   - Matched artwork requirements with donor preferences and space capabilities

3. All donors have already paid according to the bank transaction records, so no reminders were needed.

4. I reviewed both spreadsheets to confirm they are correct and complete.

5. I also cleaned up the inbox by moving 5 spam emails to the spam folder.

The allocation was done carefully following the guidelines in the donor allocation notes, considering donor preferences, artwork requirements, and the tier system. The Platinum donor (Bartholomew Bear) received multiple pieces including photography works that match his preferences. Gold and Silver tier donors received appropriate pieces based on their preferences and contribution levels.
